quarterly_data.quarter: Shenzhen Sunlord Electronics annual report: 2025 Annual Report (02-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 results (annual report): revenue RMB 6.75 billion, up 14.39% from RMB 5.90 billion; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 1.02 billion, up 22.71%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 978.21 million, up 25.23%; operating cash flow RMB 1.70 billion, up 18.71%. The board letter puts total net profit at RMB 11.41 hundred million and calls revenue and profit record highs. Quarterly revenue: Q1 RMB 1.46 billion, Q2 RMB 1.76 billion, Q3 RMB 1.81 billion, Q4 RMB 1.71 billion; quarterly net profit attributable: Q1 RMB 233.15 million, Q2 RMB 252.73 million, Q3 RMB 283.20 million, Q4 RMB 251.94 million. Gross profit RMB 24.71 hundred million (+14.83%), gross margin 36.64% (up 0.14); quarterly gross margin Q1 36.56%, Q2 36.78%, Q3 36.84%, Q4 36.33% (Q4 2024: 34.49%). The company said some raw-material purchase prices and labour costs kept rising, partly absorbed through larger scale, higher efficiency, process improvements and more balanced production.

quarterly_data.quarter: Shenzhen Sunlord Electronics annual report: 2025 Annual Report (02-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: AI data-center products (annual report): the company said it has built a full industrial and product layout around data centers and covers all module-type customers for chip-side power supply of GPU, CPU and ASIC chips. R&D project status: high-power-density 2-phase TLVR power devices for AI-server xPU power modules are in volume supply to leading domestic and overseas customers; 4-phase TLVR power devices for the same use have been qualified by a leading overseas customer; high-power devices for data-center HVDC 800V have begun small-batch delivery to leading overseas customers; power devices for eSSD power supply are in volume delivery; filter devices for high-speed communication protocols are in volume delivery to mainstream domestic customers. Its new-structure (leadframe-less) TP-series polymer and TM-series MnO2 tantalum capacitors are favoured in eSSD, high-end consumer electronics and AI servers, and its copper-magnet co-fired platform inductors are described as an important AI-inductor category well received in AI servers.

quarterly_data.quarter: Shenzhen Sunlord Electronics annual report: 2025 Annual Report (02-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D (annual report): 2025 R&D investment RMB 619,482,058.25, up 22.73%, 9.18% of revenue (8.56% in 2024), none capitalised, the rise attributed to R&D staff pay and project materials; R&D staff 1,598 (+18.02%), 17.40% of employees; 992 valid patents at end-2025. Other project status: a zero-defect automotive integrated power inductor and a safety-grade high-reliability automotive filter inductor have been qualified by a leading domestic customer and a leading overseas OEM respectively; filter inductors for automotive camera-chip platforms are qualified by a leading global automotive chip maker and in volume supply; SOFC core materials are in mass-production development.
